title: Ameris Bank Strengthens South Carolina Leadership with Market Presidents in Midlands, Charleston and Greenville
summary: Ameris Bank is strengthening its leadership in South Carolina with the appointment of market presidents in the Midlands, Charleston and Greenville, three important growth areas across the state. Marvin Robinson has been named Midlands market president, overseeing Ameris Bank’s commercial and retail banking operations throughout the Lexington and Columbia areas. P.J. Watson has joined Ameris Bank as Charleston market president, leading market strategy, customer relationships and business development efforts across the Charleston region.
